name: Chin Hin Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Chin Hin Group Berhad 与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 签订为期三年的战略联盟谅解备忘录，由后者供应焊接网、钢丝网及钢筋，并给予其优先供应权；同时与 Universiti Sains Malaysia 的谅解备忘录年内无重大进展。公司亦就多项诉讼事项作出公告，并提呈股东授权更新及股份回购授权等常规议案。
overview_en: In 2026, Chin Hin Group Berhad entered into a three-year strategic alliance MOU with EC Excel Wire Holdings for the supply of welded mesh, wire mesh and steel bars, granting it a first right of refusal; meanwhile, the MOU with Universiti Sains Malaysia saw no material development during the year.

segments.name: 钢丝网制造
segments.note: 今年与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 签订战略联盟谅解备忘录，由后者供应焊接网、钢丝网及钢筋，年内无进一步重大进展。
segments.note_en: This year the company entered into a strategic alliance MOU with EC Excel Wire Holdings for the supply of welded mesh, wire mesh and steel bars, with no further material development during the year.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 的谅解备忘录截至2026年8月27日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development on the MOU with EC Excel Wire Holdings as at 27 August 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 的谅解备忘录截至2026年5月21日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development on the MOU with EC Excel Wire Holdings as at 21 May 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告与 EC Excel Wire Holdings 的谅解备忘录截至2026年2月26日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development on the MOU with EC Excel Wire Holdings as at 26 February 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 EC Excel Wire Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 签订为期三年的谅解备忘录，后者将成为公司未来项目的焊接网、钢丝网及钢筋供应商，并获优先供应权。
actions.text_en: Entered into a three-year MOU with EC Excel Wire Holdings Sdn. Bhd., under which the latter will be the supplier of welded mesh, wire mesh and steel bars for the company's future projects and is granted a first right of refusal.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告涉及与 Universiti Sains Malaysia 的谅解备忘录状态更新、多项诉讼事项，以及股东授权更新和股份回购授权等公司层面事项。
